VERSION 6 · WHAT CHANGED

Cleaner basket, sign-out everywhere, every button tested.

Norvex Integrated Enterprises Ltd — supply & procurement system. This tour shows the three things fixed in this round, with the real screens.

1 · The basket is now one column of truth

Payment instructions used to sit inside the basket and compete with the totals. They now live only on the Pay step. The delivery estimate no longer floats in its own left-hand panel — the free-delivery meter is part of the sticky order summary, so nothing is pushed around or covered at any width.

  • "How you can pay" block removed from the basket — it belongs to #/checkout.
  • Delivery estimate docked inside the order summary under the total, with the same live meter (add KES 124,080 for free delivery · 17%).
  • Basket now reads Basket lines · Order summary · Buying on account? — three clear jobs, no duplicates.

2 · Same basket on a phone — nothing clipped

Lines stack, the meter stays with the summary, and the sign-out link sits right under the account name.

Checked at 6 widths

320 · 375 · 390 · 768 · 1024 · 1440 — 17 routes each. Automated audit compares element boxes for overflow and overlap on every one.

  • 102 checks, 0 layout problems, 0 page errors.
  • Rail identity truncates with an ellipsis instead of spilling out of the rail.
  • Context band dot aligns to the first line at mobile.

3 · Sign-out is findable in four places

You told us you could not find it. It is now top-right of the account page, bottom-left of the console rail, inside the header avatar menu, and inline in the basket summary next to "My account".

  • Account page — Sign out button beside "Desk".
  • Console rail — ⏻ glyph on your name card (hidden when browsing as a guest).
  • Console command bar — your name chip is now a live account slot on desktop.
  • Basket summary — "My account · Sign out". Signing out keeps your basket.
